notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Goblins.
description:
Cast Brightstone Ritual by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Pili-Pala by paying {R} and tapping it, copying Brightstone Ritual.
Resolve the copy of Brightstone Ritual, adding at least {R}{R}
Activate Pili-Pala by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.
